description: ACCDB: DAO read-only SQL SELECT of all 8 domain functions (DLookup, DCount, DSum, DMin, DMax, DAvg, DFirst, DLast) without criteria across Text, Long, Currency, Double, DateTime, YesNo, Memo, expression expr, and bare SELECT without FROM. Captures Field metadata (Name/Type/Size/Attributes) and exact VARIANT values.

question.description: ACCDB: DAO read-only SQL SELECT of all 8 domain functions (DLookup, DCount, DSum, DMin, DMax, DAvg, DFirst, DLast) without criteria across Text, Long, Currency, Double, DateTime, YesNo, Memo, expression expr, and bare SELECT without FROM. args.text: SELECT DLookup('Name', 'Items') AS DL_Txt, DLookup('Qty', 'Items') AS DL_Lng, DLookup('Price', 'Items') AS DL_Cy, DLookup('Rate', 'Items') AS DL_Dbl, DLookup('Dt', 'Items') AS DL_Dt, DLookup('Active', 'Items') AS DL_Bool, DLookup('Descr', 'Items') AS DL_Memo FROM Groups WHERE Gid = 1
SELECT DCount('*', 'Items') AS DC_Star, DCount('Qty', 'Items') AS DC_Qty, DCount('Cat', 'Items') AS DC_Cat, DCount('Descr', 'Items') AS DC_Memo FROM Groups WHERE Gid = 1
SELECT DSum('Qty', 'Items') AS DS_Qty, DSum('Price', 'Items') AS DS_Cy, DSum('Rate', 'Items') AS DS_Dbl, DSum('Qty * 2', 'Items') AS DS_Expr FROM Groups WHERE Gid = 1

SELECT DMin('Qty', 'Items') AS DMin_Qty, DMax('Qty', 'Items') AS DMax_Qty, DMin('Name', 'Items') AS DMin_Txt, DMax('Name', 'Items') AS DMax_Txt, DMin('Dt', 'Items') AS DMin_Dt, DMax('Price', 'Items') AS DMax_Cy FROM Groups WHERE Gid = 1
SELECT DAvg('Qty', 'Items') AS DA_Qty, DAvg('Price', 'Items') AS DA_Cy, DAvg('Rate', 'Items') AS DA_Dbl FROM Groups WHERE Gid = 1
SELECT DFirst('Name', 'Items') AS DF_Txt, DLast('Name', 'Items') AS DL_Txt, DFirst('Qty', 'Items') AS DF_Qty, DLast('Qty', 'Items') AS DL_Qty FROM Groups WHERE Gid = 1
SELECT DCount('*', 'Items') AS C, DSum('Qty', 'Items') AS S, DLookup('Name', 'Items', 'ID = 2') AS N
